dataset_semantics: official ordered CIFAR-10 test set, ToTensor unit pixels, no augmentation

bn_semantics.label: EVAL_DEFAULT_RUNNING_STATS
bn_semantics.definition: initial weights with BatchNorm eval mode, running_mean=0, running_var=1, num_batches_tracked=0

bn_semantics.label: TRAIN_ORDERED_TEST_BATCH_STATS
bn_semantics.definition: initial weights with BatchNorm train mode; current statistics are computed over consecutive ordered test batches of 128 (final batch 16); running statistics update but are not used for current-batch outputs

collapse_definition: maximum route share equals exactly 1.0 on all 10000 ordered test inputs
interpretation: The train-mode test-batch result is a precisely registered BN-semantic diagnostic, not the literal first augmented shuffled training batch. Report default seed separately from the 19 fresh seeds. A collapse is scoped to the official test distribution and does not prove global constancy or identify a particular bias parameter as causal.
